legal_basis: From version code 1030005, choosing I AGREE on the disclosed startup notice enables aggregate usage measurement. Choosing I DO NOT AGREE closes the game without sending statistics. Statistics can be stopped and unsent counts erased in Help > Settings without affecting play. Accepting the startup notice again enables statistics again. We do not treat this bundled startup agreement as proof of freely given consent or as verified parental consent; applicable legal requirements and child protections still apply. Earlier versions 1030000–1030004 used a separate adult PIN opt-in in Settings. Public record sharing requires a separate adult-managed choice, community rules and explicit Share; sharing can be stopped and records removed. Necessary service security and moderation are performed to operate that requested feature and protect users, subject to applicable law. Support correspondence is processed to answer the request and comply with legal obligations. Applicable child-protection, parental-authorization and data-protection rights take precedence; a local PIN does not verify parental identity. Contact goncalo@clemir.com for assistance.
provider_practices: The developer has confirmed that Cloudflare is used only for Tunnel/proxy routing and protection for stats.clemir.com; Cloudflare Web Analytics, Logpush and other optional collection services are not enabled. Cloudflare necessarily processes IP addresses and connection/security information and may retain service data under its own published terms and privacy policy. Its role varies by data category, including processor for customer content and controller for some service data. Our collector does not retain raw request, IP or user-agent logs. We do not claim Cloudflare retains no logs or that its service-data retention equals our 90-day aggregate retention. No advertising, analytics SDK or third-party marketing tracker is embedded in the app. Public privacy, community and removal pages are also hosted on GitHub Pages at pereiragoncalo.github.io/Scorer. When you visit those pages, GitHub processes web request information, including IP addresses, under its own privacy statement. These static pages contain no advertising, embedded analytics, contact form or game-record uploads. This website hosting is separate from gameplay requests to stats.clemir.com.
children_practices: Scorer World includes children and teenagers in its audience. Public record sharing is locked by default. The public table can be viewed without enabling sharing. An adult must complete a local adult-age declaration and configure/unlock a PIN before sharing; the date of birth is checked locally and discarded, never transmitted. This is a local access safeguard, not verified parental identity or proof of parental consent. An adult should supervise the decision and use pseudonyms, never a child’s full name, school or contact details. Sharing requires community rules and an explicit action; submissions await moderation. Reports, blocking, withdrawal and support are available. In version code 1030005 and later, I AGREE on the startup notice enables aggregate usage counters; I DO NOT AGREE closes the game without sending them. Startup agreement does not verify adult age or parental authority. Statistics can be stopped in Settings; accepting the startup notice again enables them again. Shared names must be pseudonyms, not personal information. A safety reminder precedes sharing. We do not collect location, contacts, advertising IDs or behavioural profiles.
international_transfers: The developer operates the collector; Cloudflare routes traffic through an international network and may process connection data outside your country, including outside the EEA. EU-only residency is not promised. Cloudflare publishes a Data Processing Addendum and information about European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses and, where applicable to the relevant entities and transfers, Data Privacy Framework participation. These mechanisms apply according to the provider’s actual terms and applicable law; this policy does not claim an individual account audit or a separately verified contract. See the official provider references below and contact the developer about applicable safeguards.
